import requests, json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
# ---------- BLOSUM62 + NW (self-contained) ----------
b62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V B Z X *
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0 -2 -1 0 -4

K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 0 1 -1 -4
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1 -3 -1 -1 -4
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 -4
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2 -2 -1 -2 -4
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2 0 0 0 -4
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -4
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3 -4 -3 -2 -4

V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4 -3 -2 -1 -4
B -2 -1 3 4 -3 0 1 -1 0 -3 -4 0 -3 -3 -2 0 -1 -4 -3 -3 4 1 -1 -4
Z -1 0 0 1 -3 3 4 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 1 4 -1 -4

* -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 -4 1"""
L=b62.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); D={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): D[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZX*"; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
SM=np.array([[D[(a,b)] for b in AA] for a in AA],dtype=np.int64)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,idx['X']) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    a,b=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-10**9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,np.int64); Ix=Mm.copy(); Iy=Mm.copy()
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=pM.copy(); pY=pM.copy(); Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    sub=SM[a][:,b]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm,px,py=Mm[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        st=np.vstack([pm[:-1],px[:-1],py[:-1]])
        Mm[i,1:]=st.max(0)+sub[i-1]; pM[i,1:]=st.argmax(0)
        ox,ex=pm+go,px+ge; Ix[i]=np.maximum(ox,ex); pX[i]=np.where(ox>=ex,0,1)
        row=Mm[i]; iy=Iy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            oy,ey=row[j-1]+go, iy[j-1]+ge
            if oy>=ey: iy[j]=oy; pY[i,j]=0
            else: iy[j]=ey; pY[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; s=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if s==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;s=ns
        elif s==1: A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;s=ns
        else: A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;s=ns
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2))

txt=open("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/sdd3_homologs.fasta").read()
seqs={}; names={}
for blk in txt.split("\n>"):
    blk=blk.strip().lstrip(">")
    if not blk: continue
    ln=blk.split("\n"); hdr=ln[0]
    acc=hdr.split("|")[1] if "|" in hdr else hdr.split()[0]
    seqs[acc]="".join(ln[1:]).strip()
    names[acc]=re.sub(r"\s+(OX|GN|PE|SV)=.*","",hdr.split(" ",1)[1] if " " in hdr else "")[:48]
sdd3="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q12496.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
SITES={60:"H (Zn ligand 1)",63:"E (catalytic, proton acceptor)",64:"H (Zn ligand 2)",135:"E (active site 2)",153:"E (Zn ligand 3)"}
rows=[]
for acc,s in seqs.items():
    if acc=="Q12496": continue
    A1,A2=nw(sdd3,s); i=j=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(A1,A2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-' and i in SITES: mp[i]=c2
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A1,A2) if x==y and x!='-'); aln=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A1,A2) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,name=names.get(acc,""),pid=round(100*ident/aln,1),
                     **{f"{p}{SITES[p][0]}":mp.get(p,"-") for p in SITES}))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pid",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print(df.to_string())
cols=[c for c in df.columns if re.match(r"\d+[HE]$",c)]
print("\nConservation of SDD3 catalytic residues across", len(df), "structural homologs:")
for c in cols:
    exp=c[-1]; frac=(df[c]==exp).mean()
    print(f"  SDD3 {c[:-1]:>4s} ({exp}): conserved in {int((df[c]==exp).sum())}/{len(df)} = {100*frac:.0f}%   variants seen: {dict(df[c].value_counts())}")
df.to_csv("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/sdd3_active_site_conservation.csv",index=False)

# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
fr=[100*(df[c]==c[-1]).mean() for c in cols]
lab=[f"{c[:-1]}\n{c[-1]}" for c in cols]
bars=ax.bar(lab,fr,color=["#4C72B0","#C44E52","#4C72B0","#937860","#4C72B0"])
for b,f in zip(bars,fr): ax.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,f+1.5,f"{f:.0f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_ylabel("% of homologs retaining the residue")
ax.set_xlabel("SDD3 position and residue (blue = zinc ligand, red = catalytic Glu, brown = second active-site Glu)")
ax.set_title(f"M16 active-site residues are retained across {len(df)} SDD3 structural homologs")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
